speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your urine or stool color, such as dark urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).

Given your age, gender, history of autoimmune disease (ulcerative colitis), and symptoms of fatigue and pruritus, we need to confirm the specific type of liver damage. Can you describe any skin rashes, particularly on your palms or soles, or joint pain? Also, please confirm if you have experienced unexplained weight loss or night sweats recently.

REQUEST TEST: Antimitochondrial Antibody (AMA), Liver Function Panel (ALT, AST, Alk Phos, Bilirubin).
